rows: Every match of the ATP and WTA tournaments in play this week, one row per match

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Every match of the ATP and WTA tournaments in play right now (ESPN scoreboard), one row per match: tournament, draw, round, both sides with seeds, status, winner and set-by-set score. tour is ATP for men's draws, WTA for women's, MIXED for mixed doubles. Use matches_on() for another day and tournament_matches() for a past event.
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current week's tennis matches across both tours, scheduled, live and completed. `score` reads from the winner's side; `sets` holds per-set games for each side.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Completed singles results this week.", "sql": "SELECT tournament_name, round, winner_name, loser_name, score FROM tennis.main.current_matches WHERE status = 'completed' AND draw_type = 'singles' ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC"}, {"description": "Match count and completion by tournament and draw.", "sql": "SELECT tournament_name, draw, count(*) AS matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed FROM tennis.main.current_matches GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY tournament_name, draw"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current Tennis Matches

rows: CREATE TABLE current_matches(tour VARCHAR, "source" VARCHAR, season INTEGER, tournament_id INTEGER, event_id VARCHAR, tournament_name VARCHAR, is_grand_slam BOOLEAN, match_id VARCHAR, draw VARCHAR, draw_type VARCHAR, qualifying BOOLEAN, round VARCHAR, scheduled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, status VARCHAR, status_detail VARCHAR, court VARCHAR, side1_player_id INTEGER, side1_player_name VARCHAR, side1_country VARCHAR, side1_partner_id INTEGER, side1_partner_name VARCHAR, side1_seed INTEGER, side2_player_id INTEGER, side2_player_name VARCHAR, side2_country VARCHAR, side2_partner_id INTEGER, side2_partner_name VARCHAR, side2_seed INTEGER, winner_side INTEGER, winner_name VARCHAR, loser_name VARCHAR, score VARCHAR, side1_sets_won INTEGER, side2_sets_won INTEGER, "sets" STRUCT(set_number INTEGER, side1_games INTEGER, side2_games INTEGER, tiebreak_loser_points INTEGER)[], PRIMARY KEY(match_id));
Current ATP (top 150) and WTA (top 200) singles rankings, one row per player

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Current singles rankings for both tours, one row per player: ATP top 150 (from ESPN) and WTA top 200 (from the official WTA API). Filter tour = 'ATP' or 'WTA'. Use rankings() for WTA doubles or a deeper WTA list. player_id is in the id space named by source.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Today's ATP and WTA singles rankings as an ordinary read-only table, with points, previous position and movement. Use `rankings()` for doubles or other depths.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "The top ten of each tour.", "sql": "SELECT tour, ranking, player_name, country, points FROM tennis.main.current_rankings WHERE ranking <= 10 ORDER BY tour, ranking"}, {"description": "Biggest climbers in the latest ATP release.", "sql": "SELECT ranking, player_name, movement FROM tennis.main.current_rankings WHERE tour = 'ATP' ORDER BY movement DESC LIMIT 10"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current Tennis Rankings

rows: CREATE TABLE current_rankings(tour VARCHAR, ranking_type VARCHAR, "source" VARCHAR, ranked_at DATE, ranking INTEGER, previous_ranking INTEGER, movement INTEGER, points INTEGER, player_id INTEGER, player_name VARCHAR, first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR, country VARCHAR, birth_date DATE, age INTEGER, tournaments_played INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(tour, player_id));
